rationale: Playbook PG-TAMP-002 matched on alert ALRT-0016. The principal carol.tan@eproc.test issued write statements against public.audit_log in session c0a3840d-4115-4baf-9d96-52f9a84b12de. The standing playbook for integrity tampering snapshots the affected rows, removes the write grant from role dba, and terminates the session's backends so that no further writes land before an investigator reviews the snapshot.
rollback:
GRANT INSERT, UPDATE ON public.audit_log TO dba;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS incident_snapshot_alrt_0016;
